SELECT ID AS STOCK_ID ,SYMBOL ,NAME ,MARKET FROM T_STOCK WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_DAY IS NULL
AND ( NAME ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR SYMBOL = #{query} )
ORDER BY ID

SELECT P.TRADE_DATE ,P.OPEN_PRICE ,P.HIGH_PRICE ,P.LOW_PRICE ,P.CLOSE_PRICE ,P.VOLUME FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = P.STOCK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND S.SYMBOL = #{symbol} ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC LIMIT #{days}

WITH RANKED AS ( SELECT P.STOCK_ID ,P.TRADE_DATE ,P.CLOSE_PRICE ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.STOCK_ID ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P ) SELECT S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,B.TRADE_DATE AS START_DATE ,B.CLOSE_PRICE AS START_PRICE ,E.TRADE_DATE AS END_DATE ,E.CLOSE_PRICE AS END_PRICE ,ROUND((E.CLOSE_PRICE - B.CLOSE_PRICE) / B.CLOSE_PRICE * 100, 2) AS RETURN_RATE FROM RANKED E JOIN RANKED B ON B.STOCK_ID = E.STOCK_ID AND B.RN = #{days} + 1 JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = E.STOCK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND E.RN = 1 AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY RETURN_RATE DESC
